leadText: Shin-ichiro Miki (Japanese: 三木眞一郎 Miki Shin'ichirō) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Shin-ichiro Miki (Japanese: 三木眞一郎 Miki Shin'ichirō) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Miki was born on March 18, 1968, in , , and he became a voice actor as an adult. He was both one of the original and one of the longest-serving voice actors in , with his most famous role being James. He is also noted for voicing most depictions of and in various Pokémon media (including Pokémon the Series itself), which are left undubbed in many foreign versions of the franchise, including English. Miki is currently affiliated with the talent agency .
